statusDefinitions.done: Implementation exists and has evidence; release/browser validation may still be pending.
statusDefinitions.in_progress: Work has started but implementation or verification remains.
statusDefinitions.planned: Not implemented yet, or no evidence is recorded.

milestones.title: Foundation & project integrity
milestones.goal: Keep the existing editor stable and its project data safe.

tasks.title: Editor foundation and project workflow
tasks.summary: React/TypeScript/Vite editor shell, Storyboard editing, basic Timeline visualization, local persistence, project JSON import/export, and AI execution-plan export.

subtasks.title: Editor shell and Storyboard editing
Browser-local persistence and project JSON import/export
AI execution-plan export
Release-level browser smoke test

acceptance: npm test passes
npm run build passes
Export then re-import a project without losing shots or slot versions
Storyboard remains available from the main navigation
evidence: README.md documents the current foundation and limitations
CI evidence is linked from the task specification
tasks.notes: Progress is an estimate, not a release-readiness score.

tasks.title: Centralized UI localization and project validation
tasks.summary: Centralize user-facing UI copy in src/i18n.ts and reject malformed project data before it is loaded or imported.

subtasks.title: Centralized typed UI message catalog
Validate project structure and nested references
Test malformed imports and invalid durations
Validate migration paths for future schema versions

acceptance: Vitest covers valid sample projects and malformed structures
Invalid selected-version references are rejected
Invalid durations and canvas values are rejected
Unknown schema versions fail safely
evidence: Task report and CI run are linked from the task Markdown
tasks.notes: Schema migration becomes a priority before the new composite model is implemented.

milestones.title: Assets, references & project tracking
milestones.goal: Keep the original creative-planning workflow intact and make project progress auditable.

tasks.title: Task dashboard and per-task records
tasks.summary: Replace the hard-coded task-card list with a JSON-driven project management dashboard, phase timeline, subtasks, acceptance criteria, and evidence links.

subtasks.title: Single JSON source for milestones, tasks, subtasks, and status
Milestone timeline and phase/task drill-down UI
Link task specification Markdown and completion report
Verify dashboard JSON loading and relative links

acceptance: Dashboard reads task data from public/doc/tasks.json rather than hard-coded task cards
Milestones are displayed in timeline order
Tasks can expand to show subtasks and acceptance criteria
Each task links to its Markdown specification and report
Missing or invalid JSON produces a visible error rather than a blank dashboard
tasks.notes: Progress reflects this dashboard redesign and still requires CI/browser validation.

tasks.title: Asset library and reference profiles
tasks.summary: Manage asset metadata and reusable reference profiles, assign profiles to shots, and maintain reference roles.

subtasks.title: Asset metadata CRUD and reference-use protection
Reference profile CRUD and shot assignment
Durable media import, relinking, and preview generation
Preserve original Assets and References navigation

acceptance: Assets can be added, edited, and deleted subject to reference constraints
Reference profiles and roles remain editable
Profiles can be assigned to shots
Timeline redesign does not remove or replace Assets or References views
evidence: Task Markdown and report describe implemented scope and limitations
tasks.notes: File selection currently records metadata/source filename; do not imply media bytes are durably imported.

milestones.title: Timeline model & version workflow
milestones.goal: Build a stable editing data model before expanding the visual editing workspace.

tasks.title: Timeline editing and Version management
tasks.summary: Separate timeline placement from Version internals; support both single-clip and composite Versions, per-clip version selection, and safe editing operations.

subtasks.title: Select Clip Slot and switch existing versions
Create/duplicate versions with unique IDs
Separate Timeline Clip placement/duration from Version internals
Single Clip and Composite Version schema
Version dropdown with thumbnail, description, and add-version action
Define version-duration mismatch behavior
Undo/Redo and selection consistency for Version changes

acceptance: Each slot retains an independent selectedVersionId
Single and composite Version forms validate correctly
Switching Version does not silently move unrelated clips
New versions use unique IDs for nested layers and records
Legacy project JSON loads through an explicit migration
Unit tests cover valid/invalid composite structures and duration policies
evidence: Existing picker work merged in PR #3; newer editing work is documented in repository history
tasks.notes: Confirmed product decision: Version model C supports both single video and multi-clip/audio composites.

tasks.title: Multi-track Timeline and linked audio
tasks.summary: Introduce independent video/audio tracks and a safe linked/unlinked audio workflow.

subtasks.title: Track ordering, visibility, lock, and type rules
Represent linked source audio and independent audio clips
Unlink, move/trim independently, and relink when compatible
Waveform/clip rendering with honest unavailable states

acceptance: Linked video and audio move/trim together
Unlinked audio can move independently
Deleting or duplicating clips does not leave dangling references
Undo/Redo restores linked state and track placement
evidence: Acceptance tests and PR CI will be recorded when implementation begins
tasks.notes: Confirmed product decision: video audio defaults to linked but can be unlinked and edited independently.

milestones.title: Preview, compositing & mobile editing
milestones.goal: Connect the editing model to a real preview rather than decorative controls.

tasks.title: Preview, playback, and media compositing
tasks.summary: Implement media playback and composition for Shot, Version, and master Timeline previews, including multi-layer picture-in-picture.

subtasks.title: Preview single imported media source
Composite multiple video/image layers in z-order
Canvas drag transform and Inspector synchronization
Contain/Cover/Stretch and background fill settings
Real first/last-frame thumbnails or explicit placeholders

acceptance: Two video/image layers visibly composite in the preview
Dragging a layer updates persisted transform values
Reloading the project restores visual layout
Thumbnail failure has a clear placeholder state
No UI implies playback/rendering works when it does not
evidence: Browser media fixtures and repeatable manual QA steps will be linked from the report
tasks.notes: Current preview is limited and is not a full video compositor.

tasks.title: Advanced audio and procedural layers
tasks.summary: Add multitrack audio mixing, effects, timed text, and user-authorized procedural modules.

subtasks.title: Audio level, mute, and basic mixing
Timed text and basic effects
Sandbox and permission model for procedural modules

acceptance: Audio levels and mute state are persisted
Timing is deterministic and tested
Procedural code is not executed without explicit authorization and isolation
evidence: Automated tests and documented safety boundaries required before marking done
tasks.notes: Depends on the multi-track audio model.

tasks.title: Responsive mobile editing workspace
tasks.summary: Create a mobile-specific CapCut-inspired editing layout while preserving Storyboard, References, and Assets.

subtasks.title: Responsive preview and compact editing controls
Touch-friendly timeline scrubbing and clip selection
Mobile Inspector and Version picker
Regression check for existing main navigation

acceptance: No horizontal overflow at agreed phone viewport sizes
Core timeline selection, scrubbing, and version switching work by touch
Storyboard, References, and Assets remain reachable
tasks.notes: The screenshot guides only the editing workspace, not a replacement for the overall app.

milestones.title: History, portability & release quality
milestones.goal: Make editing recoverable, portable, and honestly verifiable.

tasks.title: Undo/Redo, recovery, and portable project bundles
tasks.summary: Provide dependable edit history and reliable project portability across browser sessions and machines.

subtasks.title: Project-data Undo/Redo history
Group rapid edits into sensible undo steps
History coverage for view state and complex media operations
Portable project/media bundle and recovery strategy

acceptance: Undo/Redo restores project data exactly for supported operations
History boundaries are tested for import and grouped edits
Portable bundle round-trip preserves references and media policy
Storage quota/error states are surfaced to the user
evidence: PR history documents current project-data Undo/Redo; task report tracks remaining scope
tasks.notes: Current history does not cover every view/playhead/preview state.

tasks.title: AI execution-plan reconciliation and MP4 export
tasks.summary: Strengthen structured AI plan interchange and evaluate browser-based final MP4 rendering.

subtasks.title: Versioned execution-plan schema and validation
Reconcile generated plans with project state
Evaluate browser render/export architecture
Render validation and downloadable output

acceptance: Execution plans validate against a documented schema
Conflicts are reported without silently overwriting user work
Export is not marked complete until a playable output is verified
evidence: A real media fixture and playback validation report are required

tasks.title: Release quality, browser QA, and deployment
tasks.summary: Verify CI, run browser smoke tests, deploy review candidates through PR workflow, and document release limitations.

subtasks.title: PR CI test, type-check, and build
Browser smoke test for critical flows
Verify GitHub Pages deployment after merge
Record release limitations and evidence

acceptance: Required CI checks pass on the exact PR head
Browser smoke-test steps and outcomes are recorded
Pages deployment is independently confirmed
Known limitations are listed in the release report
evidence: PR checks and deployment run URLs must be linked from the task report
tasks.notes: A green CI run alone does not prove Pages deployment or browser behavior.
